combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Average Bat 26</title>
<style>
/* Average Bat 26 by sammykINC — https://uiverse.io/sammykINC/average-bat-26 */
.button {
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: none;
  display: flex;
  place-items: center;
  background-color: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.button > svg {
  border-radius: inherit;
  padding: 0.5rem;
  fill: #fff;

  width: 38px;

  height: 38px;

}

.button > svg:active {
  background-color: rgba(65, 65, 65, 0.5);
}

.button > svg:not(:active) {
  animation: fadeOut 0.9s;
}

@keyframes fadeOut {
  0% {
    outline: 1px solid rgba(90, 90, 90, 0.5);

  }

  100% {
    background-color: transparent;
  }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">
  <svg viewBox="0 0 256 256" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

</button>

</body>
</html>
